questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: How do you ask where someone lives?
questions.explanation: Per chiedere dove abita qualcuno si dice 'Where do you live?'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: How do you say 'formaggio' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Formaggio' in inglese si dice 'cheese'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'A frog can ___.'
questions.explanation: Una rana (frog) sa saltare: 'A frog can jump'. 'Jump' significa saltare.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: How do you say 'coniglio' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Coniglio' in inglese si dice 'rabbit'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: How do you say the number '15' in English?
questions.explanation: Il numero 15 in inglese si dice 'fifteen'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: What is 'two times five' in English numbers?
questions.explanation: Due per cinque fa dieci. Dieci in inglese si dice 'ten'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: How do you say 'gamba' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Gamba' in inglese si dice 'leg'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Your father's father is your...
questions.explanation: Il papà del papà è il nonno, in inglese 'grandfather' (o 'grandpa').

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'The sky on a clear day is ___.'
questions.explanation: In una giornata serena il cielo è azzurro: 'The sky is blue'. 'Blue' significa blu/azzurro.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Someone says 'How are you?'. What can you answer?
questions.explanation: Alla domanda 'How are you?' (come stai?) si può rispondere 'I'm fine, thank you' (sto bene, grazie).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'In winter it is usually ___.'
questions.explanation: In inverno (winter) di solito fa freddo: 'It is cold'. 'Cold' significa freddo.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Which day comes before 'Sunday'?
questions.explanation: Prima di domenica (Sunday) viene sabato, in inglese 'Saturday'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Which is the last month of the year in English?
questions.explanation: L'ultimo mese dell'anno è dicembre, in inglese 'December'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: In which season is it usually hot and sunny?
questions.explanation: In estate di solito fa caldo e c'è il sole. Estate in inglese si dice 'summer'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'I like ___ pictures with my pencils.'
questions.explanation: Con le matite si disegna: 'I like drawing pictures'. 'Drawing' significa disegnare.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Read: 'Ben has got a blue bike. He rides it to school.' How does Ben go to school?
questions.explanation: Il testo dice 'He rides it to school' riferito alla bici: Ben va a scuola in bici.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Which word means the opposite of 'old'?
questions.explanation: Il contrario di 'old' (vecchio) è 'new' (nuovo).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'There ___ a cat in the garden.'
questions.explanation: Con un singolare come 'a cat' si usa 'there is': 'There is a cat in the garden'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'They are ___ in the park.'
questions.explanation: Il present continuous usa 'are' + verbo-ing: 'They are playing in the park'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'I ___ doing my homework now.'
questions.explanation: Con 'I' il present continuous usa 'am' + verbo-ing: 'I am doing my homework now'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: What is the -ing form of the verb 'swim'?
questions.explanation: I verbi corti con una vocale e una consonante finale raddoppiano la consonante: swim diventa 'swimming'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'The keys are ___ the bag.' (inside)
questions.explanation: 'In' significa 'dentro': 'The keys are in the bag'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'The cat is hiding ___ the sofa.' (at the back)
questions.explanation: 'Behind' significa 'dietro': 'The cat is hiding behind the sofa'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'The lamp is ___ the desk.' (next to it)
questions.explanation: 'Next to' significa 'accanto a': 'The lamp is next to the desk'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete the short answer: 'Is she your sister?' — 'Yes, she ___.'
questions.explanation: Nelle risposte brevi con 'she' si usa 'is': 'Yes, she is'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: '___ they at home?'
questions.explanation: Con il soggetto plurale 'they' si usa 'Are' nelle domande: 'Are they at home?'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Make it negative: 'She has got a bike' becomes...
options: She not has got a bike
questions.explanation: Con 'she' la negazione di 'have got' è 'hasn't got': 'She hasn't got a bike'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'He ___ his teeth every morning.'
questions.explanation: Al present simple con 'he' il verbo aggiunge -es: 'He brushes his teeth every morning'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'We ___ basketball after school.'
questions.explanation: Al present simple con 'we' si usa la forma base: 'We play basketball after school'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: '___ do you go to school?' (you want to know the way)
questions.explanation: Per chiedere il modo o il mezzo si usa 'How': 'How do you go to school?' (come vai a scuola?).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: '___ is that boy? He is my cousin.'
questions.explanation: Per chiedere l'identità di una persona si usa 'Who': 'Who is that boy?'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: How do you say 'salotto' in English?
questions.explanation: Il salotto, dove ci si rilassa, in inglese si dice 'living room'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Read: 'Lucy is in her bedroom. She is reading a comic.' What is Lucy doing?
questions.explanation: Il testo dice 'She is reading a comic': Lucy sta leggendo un fumetto.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Read: 'The weather is windy today, so we are flying our kite.' Why are they flying a kite?
questions.explanation: Il testo dice 'it is windy, so we are flying our kite': fanno volare l'aquilone perché c'è vento.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Which word means the opposite of 'tall'?
questions.explanation: Il contrario di 'tall' (alto) è 'short' (basso/corto).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Which word means the opposite of 'dirty'?
questions.explanation: Il contrario di 'dirty' (sporco) è 'clean' (pulito).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Choose the plural: one foot, two ___.
questions.explanation: 'Foot' (piede) ha un plurale irregolare: 'feet' (piedi).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Choose the plural: one tooth, two ___.
questions.explanation: 'Tooth' (dente) ha un plurale irregolare: 'teeth' (denti).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'A bird has got two ___.'
questions.explanation: Un uccello (bird) ha due ali: 'two wings'. 'Wings' significa ali.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'I have a bowl of ___ for breakfast.'
questions.explanation: In una ciotola ('bowl') a colazione si mangiano i cereali: 'a bowl of cereal'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: What is the past simple of the verb 'walk'?
questions.explanation: I verbi regolari formano il past simple con -ed: walk diventa 'walked'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: What is the past simple of the verb 'make'?
questions.explanation: 'Make' è irregolare: il past simple è 'made' (fece/feci).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: What is the past simple of the verb 'take'?
questions.explanation: 'Take' è irregolare: il past simple è 'took' (prese/presi).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'Last night we ___ a great film.'
questions.explanation: Con 'last night' si usa il passato. 'Watch' è regolare: 'we watched a great film'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete the question: 'Where ___ you go on holiday?'
questions.explanation: La domanda al past simple usa 'did' + verbo base: 'Where did you go on holiday?'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'I ___ at the seaside last year.' (past of 'to be')
questions.explanation: Il past simple del verbo to be con 'I' è 'was': 'I was at the seaside last year'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: What is the past simple of the verb 'come'?
questions.explanation: 'Come' è irregolare: il past simple è 'came' (venne/venni).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'They are going ___ watch a film tonight.'
questions.explanation: Il futuro con 'going to' richiede 'to' + verbo base: 'They are going to watch a film'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'I ___ going to study tonight.'
questions.explanation: Con 'I' si usa 'am going to': 'I am going to study tonight'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'She is going to ___ a cake for the party.'
questions.explanation: Dopo 'going to' si usa il verbo base: 'She is going to bake a cake'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Read: 'Yesterday Paul visited the museum. He saw many old paintings.' What did Paul see?
questions.explanation: Il testo dice 'He saw many old paintings': Paul ha visto molti quadri antichi.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Read: 'Emma is going to be a vet. She loves animals.' What is Emma going to be?
questions.explanation: Il testo dice 'Emma is going to be a vet': Emma da grande farà la veterinaria.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Read: 'The train leaves at ten and arrives at noon.' What time does the train leave?
questions.explanation: Il testo dice 'The train leaves at ten': il treno parte alle dieci.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Choose the comparative: 'A car is ___ than a bike.'
questions.explanation: Gli aggettivi corti formano il comparativo con -er: fast diventa 'faster' (più veloce).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Choose the comparative of 'bad'.
questions.explanation: 'Bad' è irregolare: il comparativo è 'worse' (peggiore).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Choose the superlative: 'This is the ___ book in the library.' (big)
questions.explanation: Il superlativo degli aggettivi corti si forma con 'the ___-est': big diventa 'the biggest'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'There are ___ apples in the basket.'
questions.explanation: Nelle frasi affermative con plurali si usa 'some': 'There are some apples'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Complete: 'How ___ sugar do you want?'
questions.explanation: Con i nomi non numerabili (sugar) si usa 'how much': 'How much sugar do you want?'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Choose the correct possessive pronoun: 'This bag is ___.' (it belongs to me)
questions.explanation: Da solo, senza un nome dopo, si usa il pronome possessivo 'mine': 'This bag is mine'.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Read: 'We didn't go out because it was raining heavily.' Why didn't they go out?
questions.explanation: Il testo dice 'we didn't go out because it was raining': non sono usciti perché pioveva forte.

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: What is the past simple of the verb 'write'?
questions.explanation: 'Write' è irregolare: il past simple è 'wrote' (scrisse/scrissi).

questions.subject: inglese
questions.question: Choose the superlative of 'good'.
questions.explanation: 'Good' è irregolare: il superlativo è 'the best' (il migliore).
